name: se-ship-repair
title: Space Exploration: Ship Repair
author: LockeWatts
description: Your first spaceship is the one you crashed in. The wreck at the crash site becomes a repair site: rebuild its hull, systems and propulsion step by step, and it is replaced on the spot by a working Space Exploration spaceship. Also adds costly crude recipes that make spaceships buildable from rocket science. Space Exploration's own recipes are unchanged.
